pair_reasons: All four get the core lifecycle right: the store and filename, the fold, the three-term open guard keyed on $PWD, the asymmetric rc table, all four producers, the six discharge sites, the deathwatch as a non-discharger, and all five consumers. No output contradicts a key item. Y loses to W, X and Z on verified citation accuracy. About 11 of the ~30 Y citations checked are off by several lines: the whole rung ladder (:1965-1975 vs the real :1972-1983), the wrap-ledger jq and pane lines, the session-continue jq and fallback, and three handoff-fire consequence-arm comments. Y also leaves out that the self-close discharge comes after the terminal refusal and that the drain reads its verdict off stderr, and it wrongly says the undocumented-rc goal outcome is 'not stated'. W, X and Z trade verified strengths that roughly cancel. X alone verifies that the cc-custody header's 'returns from sc_announce_before_retire' claim is false (4344 makes no custody call) and alone covers the malformed-token guard (:146-149) and the stale :44-46 TTL citation. X is also the only one to check the cloud-retire-terminal dry-run and retire-success preconditions. But X misses the handoff-fire:3520 and session-continue:724 ':197' stale citations and misplaces two deathwatch quotes. W catches 3520 and :197 but leaves :7087/:7100 unchecked and misnames what sits at :8936. Z covers all four M6 and both M7 stale citations but misses :3558->:9064 and misplaces the deathwatch quote (:47). None of these is a clear material edge, so W, X and Z tie pairwise.
